thread:
alex: Hey team — customer reports a ~15% spike in 502s from the edge for hosted inference during large-batch embeddings (us-west). Happening since 02:10 UTC. Can someone triage?
jamie: Thanks Alex — any repro payloads or request IDs?
alex: Sending sample request we used for repro: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "embed-large-v1",
  "inputs": [<~2000 short texts>]
}
```
It reproduces locally against staging via frontdoor URL with header X-Tenant: acct-12345 — returns 502 ~1/6 tries.
priya: Customer says it started after they increased batch_size from 128 -> 1024. Might be correlated.
tasha: Seen similar when KV cache + batching cause upstream envoy window stalls. Can you grab the edge proxy trace id? any x-request-id headers from failed responses?
alex: One failed response had header x-request-id: r-8f4c2a and x-edge-node: edge-usw-12. I'm pasting a shortened edge proxy log: 
```
[2023-11-14T02:12:11Z] r-8f4c2a edge-usw-12 upstream reset before headers, code=502 conn=0/1 keepalive=busy
[2023-11-14T02:12:11Z] r-8f4c2a route: /v1/embeddings upstream: embed-pool-82 backpressure=high queued=23
```
jamie: Good, queued=23 indicates queuing in front of the upstream pool. Can you confirm if embed-pool-82 is on Dedicated or shared-hosted?
alex: It's hosted shared (pool auto-scaled).
tasha: If pool is shared and batch size jumped, runtime may be holding many long-lived streams causing h2 window saturation. Quick mitigation: ask customer to lower batch_size to 256 or enable chunked batching. Also temporarily route them to a smaller model variant or to Dedicated if available.
priya: Will relay mitigation. Any longer-term fixes?
jamie: We'll add autoscale alarm on queue depth + per-pool inflight windows. Also add a circuit that rejects overly large batch_size at frontdoor with 413 or suggest chunking. Need to follow up with runtime team for KV cache pressure metrics.
deploy-bot: rollout started: increase-embed-pool-min-alloc to 4 -> 8 for embed-pool-82 (canary 2 nodes)
alex: Thanks — can someone watch for 502 rate in next 15m and ping customer when mitigated? :eyes:
jamie: Watching now, will update in thread.
priya: Customer notified, they lowered their batch to 256 and are testing. We'll update with results. :thumbsup:
